narrative_summary: ALAB up 34.3% week-to-date through 2026-05-22 11:01 ET on AI infrastructure demand and analyst PT hikes. Evercore ISI raised PT to $297 from $215 (Tuesday this week). RBC reiterated Outperform with PT raised to $250 from $225, citing Amazon's expanded Anthropic deal — Scorpio X switches ramping for Trainium3 racks in Q3 driving H2 revenue. Q1 results: 14% sequential revenue increase, 93% YoY growth on AI data center demand. President & COO Sanjay Gajendra sold 2,282 shares 2026-05-18 for ~$532,121.
